newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr ends firmer, but rate concerns persist.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr ends firmer, but rate concerns persist.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended firmer at C$1.3737 (US$0.7279) on Friday after recovering from earlier weakness prompted by sluggish Canadian trade numbers, dealers said * Traders said rumors of a large option play in mid-morning trade helped to offset early morning weakness that pushed the Canada unit down to C$1.3788 (US$0.7252).
Traders said some investors called for a rate hike in Canada based on the strength of the Canadian economy and the expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve would raise rates soon.
Canada's central bank raised its key bank rate three weeks ago in an attempt to shore up a weak Canadian dollar.
"Obviously, the key thing driving the currency right now are the prospects for Bank of Canada policy," said Michael Gregory, economist and strategist with Lehman Brothers.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose against the German mark to 1.3036 marks from 1.3021 marks at Thursday's close, but fell to 83.98 Japanese yen from Thursday's 84.08 yen.
